text:
**30 mpg (US) ≈ 7.8 L/100 km**

Working:
- 1 US gallon = 3.78541 litres
- 1 mile = 1.609344 km

Fuel used per 100 km = (100 ÷ 1.609344) miles ÷ 30 mpg = 2.0712 gallons
2.0712 gal × 3.78541 L/gal ≈ 7.84 L

Quick formula: L/100 km = 235.2 ÷ mpg (US), so 235.2 ÷ 30 ≈ 7.84.

Note that US gallons are smaller than imperial gallons, so don't use the imperial conversion (282.5 ÷ mpg), which would give about 9.4 L/100 km.
